sentences.text: They can drag off station in storms, be struck by vessels, sink, or have their lights fail.
The Light List warns mariners not to rely on buoys alone for position.
Use them as a guide, and cross-check with charted features, depths and GPS.
If you find an aid off station or not working, report it to the Coast Guard.
Private aids to navigation, called PATONs, are placed by private owners like marinas.
They must follow the same color and shape rules, but they may not be maintained to Coast Guard standards.
